prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1212; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, upper and lower back pain, and intermittent headaches originating at the base of the skull. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness, and mild guarding in the lumbar region. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms, motor deficits, or reflex changes. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Over the course of 21 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, progressive therapeutic exercise targeting cervical and lumbar stabilization, soft tissue mobilization, and home exercise instruction. Pain scores decreased steadily from moderate to mild, and range of motion improved in all planes. Headache frequency diminished substantially after the midpoint of care. The patient was compliant with the home program and reported improved sleep and tolerance for daily activities.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical range of motion and improved lumbar mobility with residual mild stiffness on prolonged sitting. Ongoing self-directed exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
